leadText:
The poacher is a character of the day who appeared in The Drifting Snorunt!. This article will refer to him by his title, as he was unnamed in the episode.

The poacher pursued 's child with his very powerful . He intended to sell Snorunt on the Pokémon black market, as they are highly desired and will fetch top dollar. However, , , and stopped him, and began to battle his Glalie. Although Glalie defeated Jessie's Yanmega, James's Carnivine, and Dawn's Buneary, Ash's Chimchar (after teaming up with the Froslass) was able to defeat it. Afterwards, both the poacher and Glalie were locked in the same cage that the poacher used to trap Snorunt, and was left for Officer Jenny to deal with.
